subject: Emotions
title: Eating Disorders and Disgust
description: A short lesson to help you apply Eating Disorders and Disgust.

hook.text: People with anorexia often report intense disgust at their own bodies—not just dissatisfaction, but revulsion.

buildup.text: Research shows eating disorders involve heightened disgust sensitivity, especially toward the self.

discovery.text: The body becomes the contaminated object. Eating feels like allowing impurity inside.

twist.text: Disgust-focused therapy shows promise. Reducing overall disgust sensitivity helps normalize eating behavior.

climax.text: Eating disorders aren't about vanity. They're often disgust disorders wearing a different label.

punchline.text: The battle isn't with food—it's with self-rejection.

quiz.question: What role does disgust play in eating disorders?
